args.root_cause: plugins/TownCore/config.yml was edited at 06:47:30 (mtime) with an invalid value: shop.tax-rate: "5%" (a string) instead of a number between 0 and 1. TownCore's tick-time loadAndValidate() threw IllegalArgumentException ("shop.tax-rate must be a number between 0 and 1, got: \"5%\"") at sre.towncore.TownCore.validate(TownCore.java:55) and the plugin disabled itself at 06:47:31. The same edit also changed spawn.welcome-message to a Season 3 announcement, which looks like an intentional admin change and was left in place. AuditTrail's audit.log only records joins/quits, so the editor could not be identified.
args.actions: 1) Baseline status/log check at shift start (healthy). 2) At ~38 s status showed TownCore DISABLED; logs showed the config validation stack trace. 3) Declared incident. 4) Read plugins/TownCore/config.yml, confirmed tax-rate: "5%". 5) Wrote plugins/TownCore/config.yml changing only shop.tax-rate from "5%" to 0.05 (the evident intended 5%); all other keys unchanged. 6) Searched for a non-disruptive re-enable path: `plugman enable TownCore` and `towncore reload` are unknown commands; no plugin manager installed. 7) Ran `reload confirm` (chosen over a full process restart). The reload produced two consecutive plugin disable/enable cycles (06:48:11->06:48:25 and 06:48:31->06:48:37) and a ~10 s watchdog stall; both players were disconnected (audit.log: quit 12:48:27/28) and rejoined at 12:48:40. 8) Verified: TownCore enabled since 06:48:37 with no new validation error for >70 s (well past its ~38 s tick-validation window), config on disk still holds 0.05, all 5 plugins enabled, TPS(1m) 20.0, MSPT 12.9 ms, heap 362/768 MB, both players online. No bans, no deletions, no world changes.
args.residual_risk: Whoever edited config.yml at 06:47:30 is unidentified (AuditTrail only logs joins/quits) and could reintroduce an invalid value; TownCore has no reload command and disables itself on bad config, so a config-linting step or an admin heads-up that tax-rate must be a decimal (0.05, not "5%") is advisable. I assumed 0.05 was the intended rate — if the admin wanted a different value it should be set as a plain decimal. The `/reload confirm` used to re-enable the plugin caused a brief server stall and reconnected both players; Paper warns that reload is unsupported and could leave subtle plugin state issues, though none are visible now. 5m/15m TPS averages (18.3/19.4) are still catching up from the reload stall; 1m TPS is 20.0.
